articles.title: Ari Abdul、ダークで官能的な新ALリリース
articles.excerpt: Ari Abdulが2026年11月13日(金)にニューアルバム『THE VOID』をリリースした。 全12曲を収録した本作は、彼女がこれまで築き上げてきたダークで官能的なオルタナティブポップの世界をさらに深化させた作品。孤独、愛への執着、自己肯定感の揺らぎ、そして自分自身を見失っていく感覚など、人間の内面に潜む複雑な感情を、妖しくも中毒性の高いサウンドに落とし込んでいる。 2022年のデビューシングル「BABYDOLL」で注目を集めて以来、独自の美学とミステリアスな音楽性でファンを獲得してきたAri Abdul。本作は、彼女のアーティストとしての成長と、これまで以上にパーソナルな表現への挑戦を刻んだ重要な1枚となっている。 リリース情報 https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/444…
articles.translatedTitle: Ari Abdul, dark and sensual new AL release
articles.translatedExcerpt: Ari Abdul released his new album ``THE VOID'' on Friday, November 13, 2026. This work, which includes a total of 12 songs, further deepens the dark and sensual alternative pop world that she has built so far. He captures the complex emotions hidden within humans, such as loneliness, attachment to love, a wavering sense of self-esteem, and the feeling of losing oneself, into a mysterious yet highly addictive sound. Since gaining attention with his debut single "BABYDOLL" in 2022, Ari Abdul has been gaining fans with his unique aesthetic and mysterious musicality. This work is an important record that marks her growth as an artist and her challenge to create a more personal expression than ever before. Release information https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/444…

articles.title: Gang of Youths、不穏な新曲リリース
articles.excerpt: Gang of Youthsが2026年11月12日(木)にニューシングル「Benny's Video」をリリースした。 本作は、来年3月に発売予定の4thアルバム『Compañero』からのセカンドシングル。今年8月に発表された「Things Take Time」に続く作品であり、バンドが新たな創作フェーズへと踏み出したことを印象づける楽曲となっている。 本楽曲の最大の特徴は、躍動感あふれるシンセサイザーと、どこか不穏さを漂わせる音楽的なコントラスト。1992年の映画『Benny's Video』がインスピレーションの源となっており、作品に通底する不穏な空気や、人間の心理と暴力をめぐるテーマが、楽曲のダークな世界観に反映されている。 リリース情報 https://ototoy.jp/_/default/…
articles.translatedTitle: Gang of Youths releases disturbing new song
articles.translatedExcerpt: Gang of Youths released their new single "Benny's Video" on Thursday, November 12, 2026. This work is the second single from the 4th album "Compañero" scheduled to be released next March. This is the follow-up to "Things Take Time" released in August of this year, and it is a song that gives the impression that the band has stepped into a new creative phase. The biggest feature of this song is the dynamic synthesizer and the musical contrast that gives off a somewhat ominous feeling. The 1992 film Benny's Video was a source of inspiration for the song, and the film's disturbing atmosphere and themes surrounding human psychology and violence are reflected in the song's dark worldview. Furthermore, it has been announced that a new tour <Live House Tour 2027 “View From The Soyuz”> will be held at 23 live houses nationwide from February next year. They just released their new song ``99'' as a digital single the other day. The newly announced tour will take over the tour title and theme from the Zepp tour, and will deliver songs from the album "EINSTEIN = ROSEN BRIDGE" released in June of this year, as well as the new song "99", to all over the country, starting with Kokura FUSE in Fukuoka, where the band was formed. Ticket applications are available from 21:00 today.

articles.translatedExcerpt: [Saturday, July 4] Rayflower 47 prefecture tour <15th Anniversary LIVE 2026 “Moving on!”> Nagano performance. Arrived in Nagano the day before. Nagano is familiar to me, as I had a mobile classroom in Takeishi when I was an elementary school student, and a dormitory in Yatsugatake when I attended junior high and high school. Nozawana is my favorite. When you think of Nagano, you think of Shinshu soba. I go out to eat soba with the tour staff. Born and raised in the Kanto region, Sakurazawa prefers soba to udon. I like soy sauce, so I like the soup to be thick and dark. I can't understand why a staff member who grew up in the west of Akita and said, ``I get tired of strong flavors,'' is eating Shinshu soba so deliciously... I went to a second “standing bar” with some of the staff. articles.translatedExcerpt: morensoji released his 1st album "high time" on November 11, 2026. morensoji is a 4-piece band from Niigata, formed in 2024. Yui Haneda (Vo/G), Tachibana Yoshida (G/Vo), and Kazuka Igarashi (Dr/Cho) are three current university students, and former member Fumiya Yamazawa (Ba) has been added to form the current lineup. The newly released ``High Time'' is the band's first nationally distributed album containing 8 songs. This is an indie pop song with a floating feel that blends dazzling guitar sounds and soft singing voices. It is a DIY work in which the members themselves handled everything from recording to mastering to jacket design. articles.title: Beach Bunny、商業主義への怒りがテーマの新曲発売
articles.excerpt: Beach Bunnyが2026年11月10日(火)にニューシングル「Vinegar」をリリースした。 現代社会に蔓延する大量消費主義、商業主義、企業の利益優先主義に対する不満や怒りをテーマにした本作。エネルギッシュなファズポップナンバーに仕上がっている。 キャッチーなパワーポップと、歪みの効いたギターサウンドが融合した本楽曲。単なる社会批判にとどまらず、日々の生活の中で感じる違和感や息苦しさを、誰もが声を上げて歌えるロックアンセムへと昇華している。 リリース情報 https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/4429083 アーティスト情報 https://www.instagram.com/beachbunnymusic/
articles.translatedTitle: Beach Bunny releases new song about anger against commercialism
articles.translatedExcerpt: Beach Bunny released their new single "Vinegar" on Tuesday, November 10, 2026. This work explores the themes of dissatisfaction and anger towards the mass consumerism, commercialism, and corporate profit-prioritization that pervades modern society. It is an energetic fuzz pop number. This song is a fusion of catchy power pop and distorted guitar sound. More than just a critique of society, they sublimate the discomfort and suffocation felt in daily life into rock anthems that anyone can sing aloud. Release information https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/4429083 Artist information https://www.instagram.com/beachbunnymusic/

articles.title: Kings Elliot、幻想的な新曲リリース
articles.excerpt: Kings Elliotが2026年11月13日(金)にニューシングル「METEOR FROM MARS」をリリースした。 本楽曲は、彼女がこれまで一貫して追求してきた孤独、疎外感、そして他者とのつながりを求める気持ちと共鳴するタイトルを持つ作品。Kings Elliotならではの繊細な表現が印象的な1曲となっている。 タイトルが想起させるのは、どこにも完全には属せない存在であること、そして自分の居場所を探し続けること。映画のワンシーンを思わせる幻想的な世界観の楽曲に仕上がっている。 リリース情報 https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/4427578 アーティスト情報 https://www.instagram.com/kingselliot/
articles.translatedTitle: Kings Elliot releases fantastic new song
articles.translatedExcerpt: Kings Elliot released their new single “METEOR FROM MARS” on Friday, November 13, 2026. This song has a title that resonates with the feelings of loneliness, alienation, and desire for connection with others that she has consistently pursued up until now. This is an impressive song with Kings Elliot's delicate expressions. The title evokes the feeling of not being able to fully belong anywhere, and of continuing to search for one's place. The song is finished with a fantastic worldview reminiscent of a scene from a movie. Release information https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/4427578 Artist information https://www.instagram.com/kingselliot/

This album was also produced by singer-songwriter kiwano, and member Tochiki Sakina participated in writing the lyrics. Release date and song details will be announced at a later date. articles.translatedTitle: Tokinosora's new song "Brand new day" has been selected as the ending theme for the TV anime "Isekai Reinsei Jizoki"
articles.translatedExcerpt: Tokino Sora, a virtual idol belonging to the VTuber group "Hololive," has announced that her new song "Brand new day" has been used as the ending theme for the TV anime "Isekai Tensei Jizoki" which will begin broadcasting and distribution on January 6, 2027. The TV anime "Isekai Tensei Jirouki" is a TV anime based on the light novel by Yanagawa Takami, which has sold over 1.37 million copies in total. This is the story of a young aristocratic man, Bardo Cornelius (CV: Yusuke Kobayashi), who becomes the "Trinity" with the souls of a Sengoku warlord and an otaku high school student from another world, hones his business acumen and martial arts, and uses his knowledge as a weapon to rise to the top in another world. The ending theme, "Brand new day," is a song that follows the story of the main character's adventure in a different world, and also overlaps with Sora's own new step as she celebrates her 10th year as an active member.

articles.translatedTitle: Kanade releases new song “Drop The Mic!!”
articles.translatedExcerpt: Kanade released his latest work “Drop The Mic!!” on November 11, 2026. Kanade is an up-and-coming multi-creator who has become a hot topic and is attracting attention after winning the Grand Prix on the Vocaloid stage of "Mynavi Senkou Riot 2025". In this work, where the strong crackling sound that they are known for intersects with Seiya Infinity's clear singing voice, it depicts the emotions that change over time, centering on the ``second hand that starts moving''. The feeling of frustration that the future you had envisioned is moving ahead of you, and the regret of the past that you didn't notice. It describes his feelings of trying to embody his ideals and move forward despite such pain. The light and emotional sound and the straightforward affirmation of "We are infinite!" make it a positive song that will cheer you up. articles.translatedTitle: Libianca releases soulful new song
articles.translatedExcerpt: Libianca released their new single "DISTANCE" on Friday, November 6, 2026. This work depicts the complicated feelings of feeling tired of a relationship with a loved one, but not completely losing love. The theme is not to leave someone because you hate them, but to keep your distance to protect your own heart, which is a sad but realistic choice. This song is an Afrobeats/R&B number that takes advantage of Libianca's signature soulful singing voice and melancholic musicality. Rather than making a big emotional outburst, the piece quietly expresses the fatigue and loneliness that have accumulated within the heart, making it a work that evokes sympathy from the listener. articles.title: Mack Geiger、カントリーな新ALリリース
articles.excerpt: Mack Geigerが2026年11月6日(金)にニューアルバム『Dying In This House』をリリースした。 本作は伝統的なカントリーミュージックの豊かなサウンドと、人生の機微をすくい取る等身大のストーリーテリングが融合した作品。失恋、孤独、後悔、家族への愛情、そして困難の先に見いだす希望まで、人間の複雑な感情を丁寧に描き出している。 アルバムの中心にあるのは、ひとりの男が孤独や失恋、否認と向き合いながら、少しずつ自分自身を取り戻していく物語。プロデュースには、ナッシュビルのベテランプロデューサー・Keith StegallとJared Adlamを迎え、作品全体に一貫した音楽的な世界観を構築している。 リリース情報 https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/441226…
articles.translatedTitle: Mack Geiger releases new country AL
articles.translatedExcerpt: Mack Geiger released his new album ``Dying In This House'' on Friday, November 6, 2026. This work combines the rich sounds of traditional country music with life-sized storytelling that captures the subtleties of life. It carefully depicts the complex human emotions such as heartbreak, loneliness, regret, love for family, and even the hope found beyond hardship. At the heart of the album is the story of a man gradually regaining himself while dealing with loneliness, heartbreak, and denial. Produced by veteran Nashville producers Keith Stegall and Jared Adlam, they create a consistent musical worldview throughout the album. Release information https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/441226…

articles.translatedTitle: Kanpekina Hoshi releases new song “Watchi”
articles.translatedExcerpt: Kanpekina Hoshi, a three-person band based in Shimokitazawa, Tokyo, digitally released their new single "Watchi" on November 11th (Wednesday). Kanpekina Hoshi is a three-person band whose lyrics and compositions are written by Gt./Vo. Reimi Okabe, and whose sound is a cross between the lyricism of folk and the fluctuations of shoegaze. Through Japanese lyrics that describe everyday emotions and love, and delicate melodies and tones, they create a unique world of music. The new song "Watchi" is a song that depicts love for one's family and the pain and loneliness that arises within that relationship. The song expresses the family relationship where love and hate, happiness and unhappiness exist side by side, using bright and airy sounds. The song is a song that describes the joys, conflicts, and sometimes conflicting emotions that come from connecting with family in frank words, and depicts the feelings of beings who leave a mark on one's life, for better or for worse.

articles.translatedTitle: Spectrum restarts after 45 years with 3 original members, releases new song
articles.translatedExcerpt: It has been revealed that Spectrum will be restarted for the first time in 45 years. The band Spectrum had a great influence on many famous Japanese artists who are still active today, and definitely contributed to raising the level of the Japanese music scene. Currently, the single "F.L.Y" released in 1980 has been used as the background music for a video by an overseas influencer, and has become a hot topic worldwide, with over 100 million streaming views overseas, mainly in the United States, and over 5 billion total views on TikTok (as of 9/18). Meanwhile, it was decided that Spectrum would be restarted for the first time in 45 years, with original members Ichiro Nitta (Trp/Voc), Junichi Kanezaki (Trp), and Naoki Watanabe (B/Voc) taking the lead. This time, Ichiro Nitta has waited 45 years for the revival of Spectrum, the only thing he left behind in the last stage of his life...

articles.translatedExcerpt: Remi Hirano, who is active as a chanson singer and cooking enthusiast, discovered unreleased sound source recorded at the time of her debut. Nippon Columbia has announced that the CD ``Remi Hirano All About Charm'', which includes a total of 21 songs including these 4 songs, will be released on December 2, 2026. Remi Hirano made her record debut with Nippon Columbia's single ``Temptation Bayon'' in 1970, and had released a total of four singles by 1972. This time, while organizing Columbia's in-house master tapes in preparation for making CDs of the sound sources from that time, we discovered the sound sources of four unreleased songs. One of these songs, ``I'm Calling You,'' which was recorded in 1972, had only the song title written on the tape and the artist's name unknown, but when Hirano listened to it for the first time in about half a century, it was discovered that it was written by his late father, the French literary scholar/poet Shimao Hirano. articles.translatedTitle: “Remi Hirano All About Charm” will be released, including 21 songs.
articles.translatedExcerpt: It has been decided that Remi Hirano will release ``Remi Hirano All About Charm'' on Wednesday, December 2nd. Remi Hirano, who was active as a chanson singer, made her record debut in 1970 with the single "Temptation of Bayon" from Nippon Columbia. By 1972, they had released a total of four singles. This time, while organizing Columbia's in-house master tapes in preparation for making CDs of the sound sources from that time, the sound sources of four unreleased songs were newly discovered. One of these songs, ``I'm Calling You,'' which was recorded in 1972, had only the song title written on the tape and the artist's name unknown, but when Hirano listened to it for the first time in about half a century, it was discovered that the lyrics were written by his father, the late French literary scholar and poet Imao Hirano. The relevant lyrics were also found in a collection of poems written by his father that had been left at home. In addition, the unreleased song “Minato no Akari” recorded in 1970 was written by Umao Hirano.

articles.translatedTitle: The cause is myself. , released the "Love Reason" performance video. Show off your charm with elegant formation and perfect expression management
articles.translatedExcerpt: The cause is myself. has released a performance video for their new song "Love Reason." "Love Reason" is the title song of the CD single to be released on November 11th, and the music is provided by Vocaloid P/singer-songwriter syudou. The song is expressed in the unique worldview created by Syudou x Genjib, and is a crazy love song full of love. The performance video released today is a bit different from the music video, as it is captured with camera work that directly conveys the passion and three-dimensionality of the dance itself. While the flowing beauty of the formation changes permeates throughout the song, pay attention to the powerful and supple dance that does not break even in the midst of intense developments, as well as the facial expression management that perfectly expresses the worldview of the song, which is a mixture of madness and love. In addition, the costume in this video is made of shiny fabric that seems to be wrapped in surrounding light, and is made of beads of the same color.

articles.translatedTitle: OddRe:, releases jacket photo of 1st album “OddRe:”
articles.translatedExcerpt: OddRe: has released the jacket photo for their 1st album "OddRe:" to be released on January 6, 2027. This work, which bears the name of his own band, will include new songs in addition to previously released songs such as "Revival", "Suru-kun", and "Yomikan".
